# rustinion_status_page_incident (Resource)

Manages one manually-authored incident on the tenant's own status page. Only source = "manual" incidents can be managed this way — incidents the server itself opens from synthetic-check failures (source = "auto") are exclusively lifecycle-managed by that monitoring and any write against one is rejected by the API. See status_pages.rs in the main repo for that hysteresis logic.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `message` (String) The incident's opening update message, posted once at creation. Write-only: the server does not return it back on the incident, so this resource always echoes back whatever is currently in config/state rather than re-reading it — see this resource's own doc comment.
- `status` (String) One of "investigating", "monitoring", or "resolved". Changing this posts a new timeline update (using the current `message`) via the customer API's dedicated updates endpoint, since the plain update endpoint this resource otherwise uses has no `status` field at all — see this resource's own doc comment.
- `title` (String)

### Optional

- `component_id` (String) ID of the status page component this incident is about, if any. Must belong to this tenant's own status page.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned incident ID.
